body_text: We blend six world-renowned educational philosophies to create a holistic learning environment.

items.title: Reggio Emilia
items.text: Sees children as capable explorers, learning through art, music and beautiful learning spaces.

items.title: Maria Montessori
items.text: Fosters independence and self-care with hands-on materials, at each child’s own pace.

items.title: Finnish ECEC
items.text: Puts play, wellbeing and flexible routines first, without academic pressure.

image.alt: Two children painting together at a table full of colourful paint pots

items_2.title: Forest & Nature Pedagogy
items_2.text: Connects children to nature through outdoor exploration, gardening and weather play.

items_2.title: Anji Play
items_2.text: Encourages true child-led play and large-scale construction with minimal adult direction.

items_2.title: IB PYP
items_2.text: Uses inquiry and investigation so children ask questions, reflect and take action.
